column1: # The scientific law registry
# MACHINE-READABLE, and the single source of truth for what this repository
# claims to enforce. tests/ci_law_coverage.R reads this file, runs each gate,
# and refuses to pass unless every declared law was exercised, was
# non-vacuous, and had its planted defect killed.
# A law that is written but not registered is not enforced. A law that is
# registered but not exercised fails coverage. Neither can be inferred from a
# filename or a comment, which is the point: the mapping is data, not prose.
# Columns
#   law        stable identifier, emitted by the gate as [LAW] <law> EXERCISED
#   title      what the law says, for the coverage report
#   gate       the file that evaluates it and emits its evidence
#   mutation   the file that plants a defect the gate must kill
#   privacy    public          -- must run on any runner; a skip is a FAILURE
#              private-ok      -- may skip when person-level data is absent,
#                                 and that skip is EXPECTED, not unexpected
#              derived-ok      -- may skip when a PIPELINE-DERIVED input is
#                                 absent because it is excluded from version
#                                 control for size. Not a privacy claim. The
#                                 skip is expected, counted and NAMED, because
#                                 it means no runner enforces that law
